purpose: Project-canonical historical working baseline for future ingestion-method design; not an ingestion-ready or verified complete-bike database

sources.name: BikeBook
sources.result: Entire public/index.json assembled: 11120 brand/name/year records, 5957 distinct labels, 29 brands, 2002-2014. User-provided bikebook-main.zip (SHA-256 e6f1d0cfeb0c0dfe013056e03eb8decf73abb3d1567eadcd03617b56c9049bdf) supplied 10255 matching detailed bike_data records, including 10188 manufacturer URL references and 9466 catalog-photo URL references; no images were downloaded.
sources.rights: Repository AGPL-3.0 license retained. No separate data or image license confirmed; do not assume bike_data ODbL applies. Downstream reuse, hotlinking or image publication requires review.
sources.limits: The user-supplied archive has no embedded Git revision, so its SHA-256 provenance is retained separately and it is not asserted to be the pinned revision. Original combined names preserved. Model family/trim split, type, manufacturer entity, US market and complete-bike status unresolved. Some underlying entries may be framesets. Photo URLs are catalog references, not verified image rights, accessibility or model-year exactness.
